name: Jimena de la Frontera (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and purple, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Jimena de la Frontera (a castle on blue above green).
history: Municipal flag of Jimena de la Frontera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Jimena de la Frontera arms — castle on blue
